title.narrative: Institutionalise Commonwealth Meridian to support public finance management through effective debt management and improved debt data transparency

description.narrative: The project monitors progress towards providing member countries with access to Commonwealth Meridian, a debt management software tool to facilitate and promote effective debt management. The project will monitor and analyse Commonwealth- wide debt statistics through the tool enabling the Secretariat to provide more targeted technical assistance. Debt managers will also be trained to effectively use Commonwealth Meridian to accurately record and analyse debt data to ensure the debt portfolio remains within a country’s risk tolerance limits and minimise risks of debt distress.
